name_input: ESDS SOFTWARE SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED; ESDS SOFTWARE SOLUTION PVT LTD.; ESDS Software Solution Limited
export_evidence: No export record retrieved. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/esds-software-solution-private-limited loaded as a JavaScript shell with zero shipment rows rendered (counter: page states 'Shipments available for ESDS SOFTWARE SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED, refreshed daily' but rows actually seen = 0). Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript 'Client Challenge' wall. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be read from any source.
domestic_evidence: Company site https://www.esds.co.in/about-us states: "ESDS Software Solution Limited, incorporated in 2005, is an AI-enabled end-to-end IT service provider ... The company provides data center, cloud, colocation, managed services and AI infrastructure solutions for Governments and PSUs, BFSI Institutions and Enterprises." and "ESDS operates five Tier-III data centers across India, located in Nashik and Navi Mumbai (Maharashtra), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Mohali (Punjab) and Noida (Uttar Pradesh)". This is a self-description of domestic service delivery only; no GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract number or annual-report revenue split was retrieved (GeM/CPPP and annual-report pages not reachable within the tool budget).
note: Export status is unknown, not 'none_found': all four trade-data sources (ImportKey, Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo, ImportGenius) were blocked or JS-gated, so the absence of records is an access failure, not evidence of no shipments. Domestic activity is declared on the company's own site (five Tier-III data centres in India, government/PSU and BFSI clients) but no verifiable GST turnover band, tender award or contract record was obtained — hence declared_only. Declared HS 997331 (IT/cloud services) is a services code and would not normally appear in goods customs data; no HS correction is proposed here since no shipment record was seen. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in retrieved sources, not invented). PAN AABCE4981A and state Madhya Pradesh were not independently verified in this pass (registries out of scope). No rejection grounds found: no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy.
